pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following statements regarding the monetary policy transmission mechanism is most accurate?
option_a: Central banks can control short-term interest rates directly, but long-term interest rates are beyond their control.
option_b: Central banks can control long-term interest rates directly because decisions by consumers and businesses are based on these rates.
option_c: Central banks can control short-term interest rates by increasing the money supply to increase interest rates or by decreasing the money supply to decrease interest rates.
explanation_en: Central banks can control short-term interest rates directly. However, the decisions of consumers and businesses are based on long-term interest rates, which are beyond the control of central banks. Increasing the money supply will decrease interest rates and decreasing the money supply will increase interest rates.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: The government is reducing its spending to balance the budget, while the central bank is lowering its official policy rate. What will most likely be the combined effect on the economy?
option_a: The private sector as a percentage of GDP will increase.
option_b: The public and private sectors as a percentage of GDP will neither decrease nor increase.
option_c: The public sector as a percentage of GDP will increase.
explanation_en: The private sector will expand as a percentage of GDP because (1) the public sector will decrease as a percentage of GDP due to government spending cuts and (2) lower interest rates should cause the private sector to expand.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: A central bank that wants to increase short-term interest rates is most likely to:
explanation_en: Open market operations to sell securities will decrease the outstanding supply of cash balances and increase short-term interest rates. The central bank does not issue long- term bonds but may buy and sell bonds issued by the government. Decreasing reserve requirements or purchasing government securities would tend to decrease short-term interest rates.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following is currently the most-used target for central banks?
explanation_en: Inflation targeting is the most-used tool of central banks for making monetary policy decisions.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: If a bank needs to borrow funds from the Federal Reserve to fund a temporary shortage in reserves, it would borrow funds at the:
explanation_en: Banks are able to borrow from the Fed at the discount rate. The federal funds rate is the interest rate banks charge other banks to borrow reserves from other banks. The prime rate is the rate that commercial banks charge their best customers.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: Xanadu attempts to decrease its inflation rate by implementing contractionary monetary policy. Which of the following is most likely to be the long-run effect on Xanadu's trade balance as a result of the monetary policy change?
explanation_en: Contractionary monetary policy likely will cause higher domestic interest rates and attract foreign capital. As foreign capital flows in, the currency will appreciate relative to other currencies. The higher cost of its currency will result in higher cost exports that become less attractive to other countries. Xanadu's trade balance will most likely worsen.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: The open market sale of Treasury securities by the Federal Reserve is least likely to result in:
explanation_en: When the Fed sells Treasuries, it causes both short- and long-term interest rates to increase. This rate increase causes the dollar to appreciate, which reduces foreign demand for domestic goods, causing exports to decline. The interest rate increase also puts downward pressure on price levels, which causes inflation to slow.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: If a central bank implements an exchange rate targeting policy successfully, the country's inflation rate is most likely to be:
option_a: less than that of the target currency.
option_b: the same as that of the target currency.
option_c: greater than that of the target currency.
explanation_en: Successful exchange rate targeting should result in the same inflation rate in the targeting country as in the country of the target currency.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: The primary objective of a central bank is typically to:
explanation_en: Although some central banks have other stated goals including stabilizing exchange rates and achieving full employment, the primary objective for a central bank is to control inflation and promote price stability.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: The Federal Reserve has decided to increase the federal funds rate (the interest rate that banks charge each other for overnight loans). To implement this policy, the Federal Reserve will most likely:
option_a: sell government securities in the open market.
option_b: increase currency exchange rates (cause domestic currency to appreciate).
option_c: set a lower price on Treasury bills and notes that it is auctioning.
explanation_en: Selling government securities on the open market reduces bank reserves and drives up the federal funds rate. The other two statements are incorrect because the Federal Reserve does not directly control exchange rates or the prices of government securities.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: If a central bank's targeted inflation rate is above the current rate, the central bank is most likely to:
explanation_en: Buying government securities is an expansionary policy that would increase the money supply and allow the inflation rate to increase to the targeted range. Increasing reserve requirements and overnight lending rates are contractionary and would have the opposite effects.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: Which of the following fiscal and monetary policy scenarios is most likely to increase the size of the public sector relative to the private sector?
option_b: Expansionary scal policy and contractionary monetary policy.
option_c: Expansionary monetary policy and contractionary scal policy.
explanation_en: Expansionary fiscal policy tends to expand the public sector. Contractionary monetary policy tends to contract the private sector.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 15 Monetary Policy - Answers.pdf
question_en: If the U.S. Federal Reserve decides to decrease the money supply, which of the following is most likely to occur in the short run?
option_a: An increase in the real rate of interest.
option_b: A decrease in the unemployment rate.
option_c: An increase in the velocity of money similar to decrease in the money supply.
explanation_en: If the U.S. Federal Reserve decreases the money supply, an increase in nominal and real interest rates will occur. Higher real rates will cause businesses to invest less, which will cause the unemployment rate to increase. Furthermore, households will decrease purchases of durable goods, automobiles, and other items that are typically financed at short-term rates. This will decrease aggregate demand. The decrease in aggregate demand and expenditures will cause incomes to go down, which further decreases consumption and investment. Moreover, this decrease in aggregate demand will decrease real GDP and the price level in the short run and the long run.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 16 Introduction to Geopolitics - Answers.pdf
question_en: A high-net-worth investor has a long time horizon of approximately 25 years before he will shift his allocations more in favor of safer, low-risk investments. The likelihood of this investor reacting to an event categorized as a black swan risk by changing his allocations is:
explanation_en: A black swan risk is an exogenous risk with a low likelihood of occurrence, but a high short-term impact. If an investor has a long time horizon (and 25 years is considered long) before he plans to shift allocations, an event that would be categorized as a black swan risk would not cause the investor to react in any way. Reactions to these events are much more likely for investors with short time horizons.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 16 Introduction to Geopolitics - Answers.pdf
question_en: A country whose actions reflect nationalism is least likely to behave in ways that exhibit:
explanation_en: Hegemony refers to behavior that reflects globalization and noncooperation. Autarky and bilateralism both refer to behavior that reflects nationalism.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 16 Introduction to Geopolitics - Answers.pdf
question_en: Settling trade disputes and establishing agreements between trading partners most accurately describe the activities of the:
explanation_en: The World Trade Organization (WTO) deals with the global rules of trade between nations. Its main function is to ensure that trade flows as smoothly, predictably, and freely as possible.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 16 Introduction to Geopolitics - Answers.pdf
question_en: Promoting international monetary cooperation, promoting exchange stability, and assisting members experiencing balance of payments difficulties are the goals of the:
explanation_en: The IMF's main goals are promoting international monetary cooperation; facilitating the expansion and balanced growth of international trade; promoting exchange stability; assisting in the establishment of a multilateral system of payments; and making resources available (with adequate safeguards) to members.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 16 Introduction to Geopolitics - Answers.pdf
question_en: The most accurate description of the relative roles played by the International Monetary Fund, World Bank, and World Trade Organization is that the only one explicitly focused on:
option_a: expanding international trade is the World Trade Organization.
option_b: providing funding to member nations is the International Monetary Fund.
option_c: reducing poverty is the World Bank.
explanation_en: The World Bank has the explicit mission of fighting poverty. Both the WTO and IMF work to expand international trade. Both the World Bank and IMF provide funds to member nations, the World Bank for development and the IMF when member nations experience balance of payments difficulties.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 16 Introduction to Geopolitics - Answers.pdf
question_en: If the country of Smithia enacts sanctions against the political leaders of Jonesia, Smithia is said to be using:
option_c: a national security tool of geopolitics.
explanation_en: Sanctions refer to restrictions on the financial interests of specific geopolitical actors and are considered a financial tool of geopolitics.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Economics\Reading 16 Introduction to Geopolitics - Answers.pdf
question_en: A country that generally engages in bilateralism is best characterized as exhibiting:
explanation_en: Archetypes of geopolitical behavior by countries include bilateralism (cooperation and nationalism), autarky (non-cooperation and nationalism), hegemony (non-cooperation and globalization), and multilateralism (cooperation and globalization).
